title: QUEST 1
task: Peel 1x Banana Pod to verify bio-synthesis calibration.
hint: Tap Banana Pod to load it onto the bench, then press Craft. No tool needed.

title: QUEST 2
task: Forge 1x Mono-Shard using Raw Mineral + Heavy Slag.
hint: Heavy Slag goes in the TOOL slot (tap it first). Raw Mineral goes in an input slot.

title: QUEST 3
task: Prepare Banana Wafers using Peeled Banana + Mono-Shard.
hint: The Mono-Shard is a tool. Seat it in the TOOL slot, Peeled Banana as the input.

title: QUEST 4
task: Tap the Worker Drone to complete 3 scavenging sorties.
hint: Tap or hold the drone to direct its beam at scrap. Each sortie costs drone energy; feed it from the Minion Bag.

title: QUEST 5
task: Assemble 1x Field Container using Nano-Strips + Polymer Tendon.
hint: No tool required. Nano-Grid Strips and Polymer Tendon go in two input slots.
